title: Juicy Crunchy Spanish Vegetable Fideua
description: A kid friendly Spanish dish featuring herbes de provence and crunchy toast, served in a bento box, this fideua is halal friendly and perfect for a weeknight lunch

ingredients.name: fideua noodles
ingredients.notes: use a vegetarian fideua noodle option

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the fideua noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced red bell pepper and zucchini and cook until they are tender.
Stir in the herbes de provence and cook for one minute.
In a separate pan, toast the bread cubes over medium heat until they are crunchy and golden brown.
In a large bento box, combine the cooked fideua noodles, the vegetable mixture, and the toasted bread cubes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
